name: 1-edited

other17.machine: CNC milling machine No.10; locating fixture JIG-010
other17.process: Spindle speed 3000 rpm; feed rate 200 mm/min
other17.evaluation: Measure the slot width using a digital caliper.
other17.control: Record the measurements on the in-process inspection sheet and compare each sampled part with the specification and tolerance.
other17.verification: The quality engineer reviews the CCP inspection records each shift. Demonstration method only; verification has not been performed.
other17.rationale: Periodic sampling demonstrates process monitoring; no formal risk assessment has been performed.
other17.grr: Not performed: no actual measurement system study data.
other17.capability: Not performed: no actual process measurement data.
other17.doe: N; DOE has not been performed.
